* '''Playtest''' ([[IG MagnaGuard (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-igmagnaguard-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/igmagnaguard.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “Grievous is defense value +2 here. While aboard Invisible Hand, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and characters here are immune to Clash Of Sabers.”
* '''Original''' (this page, 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-igmagnaguard-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/igmagnaguard.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “Grievous is defense value +2 here. While aboard Invisible Hand, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and characters here are immune to Clash Of Sabers.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics, and the line “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” was added; same words.
*: [[File:V11-D-igmagnaguard-20190802-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E1''' ([[IG MagnaGuard (Errata)]], 29 March 2023): '''First published 29 March 2023''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/igmagnaguard.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/168657ac16eea2f516349595d99cda7cd8f849f3 commit 168657a]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-D-igmagnaguard.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/igmagnaguard.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. It is the current image. Text: “Grievous is defense value +2 here. While aboard Invisible Hand, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise and characters here are immune to Clash Of Sabers.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; new artwork (image courtesy of Tom Ramakers); re-rendered at high resolution.
*: [[File:V11-D-igmagnaguard-20230329-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
